introHtml: Our custom on sale lip balm offers a cost-effective way to keep your brand top-of-mind with a practical giveaway that recipients actually use. Choose from a variety of flavors and SPF options, all available with your logo or message imprinted in full color. The sale pricing makes it easy to order larger quantities without stretching your budget.
